metrics.label: Mutation to ready
metrics.description: Elapsed time from the interaction mutation start until the page completes the post-mutation animation-frame settle.

metrics.label: Runtime rule update
metrics.description: Instrumented Master CSS runtime ensure/delete class-rules time during the measured interaction, where a runtime exists.

metrics.label: Runtime rule delta
metrics.description: Change in public snapshot output rule entries across layers (including keyframes blocks) after the interaction.

metrics.label: Runtime style byte delta
metrics.description: Change in UTF-8 bytes for public snapshot cssText after the interaction.

metrics.label: Style recalculation
metrics.description: Trace-derived style recalculation duration during the interaction.

metrics.label: Layout
metrics.description: Trace-derived layout duration during the interaction.

metrics.label: Paint
metrics.description: Trace-derived paint and pre-paint duration during the interaction.

metrics.label: Long tasks
metrics.description: Count of trace task events at or above 50 ms during the interaction.

metrics.label: DOM nodes
metrics.description: Total DOM element count after the interaction settles.

metrics.label: Affected elements
metrics.description: Number of fixture elements intentionally touched by the scenario.

metrics.label: Computed style valid
metrics.description: 1 when the scenario assertion passes; cleanup checks alignment and temporary width during every cycle. These reads are included in measured work.

metrics.label: Cleanup valid
metrics.description: 1 when temporary DOM nodes are removed and temporary classes are absent from public snapshot usageCounts after scenarios that remove nodes.

metrics.label: Progressive adopted
metrics.description: 1 when the Master progressive variant adopted server-rendered style#master-css before interaction.

limits: This suite measures local Chromium post-load interaction cost only; it does not publish public result tables yet.
The default command is a fast internal pass with one measured round and no warmup; use INTERACTION_COST_ROUNDS and INTERACTION_COST_WARMUP_ROUNDS for review-grade repeated samples.
Master runtime and progressive variants use the built global runtime bundle and its compiled default program.
Master progressive samples fail if the page falls back to runtime rendering before the measured interaction.
Master static and Tailwind static variants are static-CSS browser controls; Tailwind CSS has no runtime rule-generation equivalent.
The new-class scenario is limited to Master runtime and progressive variants because it measures client-side rule generation.
Trace-derived event names can change across Chromium versions, so raw trace artifacts are kept for review before publishing public conclusions.
Browser scheduling, hardware, memory pressure, and unrelated local load can affect interaction timing.
